title: QBR playbook + daily follow-ups (scratchpad)
content:
Morning scratchpad — quick hits for QBRs / renewals / urgent follow-ups

Top priorities today:
- Atlas Health (renewal window: 60 days) — high priority
  - Check usage trend (tokens/day) — down 28% last 7 days (reporting: CS-2287)
  - Reach out to product manager (Priya) by EOD for root cause hypothesis (rate limiting? prompt changes?)
  - Schedule 30m sync with Solutions Eng (Diego) to run a live perf review (latency spikes at 95th pct)
  - Draft renewal conversation bullets: highlight Dedicated pilot savings, Auto-batching config they can try, and rollback/fallback plan
  - Open action: confirm billing invoice for Feb — ops flagged 1 anomalous credit (ask finance: acct 40012)

- Meridian Retail (support escalation) — medium
  - Sev2 ticket: ENG-5412 (embedding mismatch after model update) — owner: eng oncall
  - Today: confirm workaround (pin previous model) and advise customer on ETA for fix (ETA w/ eng: 1–2 business days)
  - Note to self: pull embedding deltas chart before noon and attach to reply

- CascadeEdu (QBR slides prep) — low/medium
  - Slide list to build: 1) Health summary (uptime, latency trends) 2) Usage & cost (tokens, $/1k) 3) Recommendations (batching + quantization) 4) Roadmap ask (private deploy timeline)
  - Data sources: console/dashboards -> per-route latency, Optimize suggestions export
  - TODO: upload draft deck to Confluence and share for review by 2026-04-08

Daily outbound cadence (today):
- 09:15 — Atlas Health quick check-in (short email + attach trend snips)
- 11:00 — Sync w/ Solutions Eng (Diego) re: perf spike investigation
- 14:00 — Internal review of QBR deck (quick run-through with Priya)
- 16:00 — Follow up with Finance re: Atlas invoice anomaly

Notes / talking points for Atlas renewal call:
- Current pain: increased P95 latency when avg seq len > 1024 -> likely KV cache pressure / kernel mismatch
- Short-term: can route heavy requests to a cheaper variant during peak (policy: routing by latency)
- Medium-term: Dedicated pool with pinned GPUs will guarantee throughput SLOs and reduce token unit cost by ~18% (estimate)
- Offer: 3-month Dedicated pilot + automatic fallback to hosted API during initial rollout (SLA + rollback plan)
- Risks to surface: data ingress egress, compliance needs for PHI (ask security for private-deploy checklist)

Open questions / things to chase:
- Who on Legal can expedite the DPA addendum for Atlas? (Slack: @legal-rapid)
- Is there a cache warming script we can run prior to their QBR demo? (ping eng: infra-team)
- Confirm if Atlas is on multi-region routing or single region (they asked for EU soon)

Quick message snippets (copy-paste-ready):
- To Atlas PM: "Hey — quick note: saw a drop in daily usage and some P95 latency spikes. Can we pair for 15m today to look at recent request shapes and rule out prompting changes? I can loop Diego from Solutions Eng. FYI: I’ll also check invoices with finance. — Ashley"
- To Engineer oncall: "ENG-5412: embedding mismatch for Meridian Retail. Temporary mitigation: rolling back to model v1.12 cuts deltas by 98%. Need patch ETA and a short postmortem. — CS"

Personal reminders / scratch notes:
- Prep two simple graphs for Atlas: tokens/day trend (30d) and 95th latency by seq-length bucket
- Capture Optimize suggestions: batching config id + expected cost delta (percent)
- Re-check customer feedback doc for CascadeEdu demo notes (they liked stream chunks idea)
- If no reply from Legal by 2026-03-26 -> escalate to CS manager for direct intro

End-of-day backlog snapshot:
- Pending replies: Atlas PM, Finance, Eng oncall, Legal
- Drafts to finish: Atlas renewal bullets, CascadeEdu QBR slide skeleton
- Blockers: Eng bandwidth for debug (Diego will confirm at 11:00)

Notes to self (less formal):
- keep messages short, call out concrete asks (time, data, decision)
- prioritize accounts with imminent renewals or active outages
- use the per-route breakdown screenshot from Console (token cost view) — customers respond to $ numbers

------
Versioning: quick working doc. Final QBR deliverables will be moved into shared confluence/drive folder and cleaned up.
